title: Dicta Adae ad Seth (Words of Adam to Seth)

details.intro:
The Dicta Adae ad Seth (Words of Adam to Seth) is a brief testamentary address in which the dying Adam summons his son Seth and discloses the heavenly secrets and the prophetic history of the world revealed to him after the Fall.

Adam instructs Seth concerning the tablets of stone and clay upon which the primeval wisdom must be engraved to survive the twin destructions of flood and fire, a motif echoing Josephus (*Ant.* 1.70–71) and the *Life of Adam and Eve*.
details.provenance:
Language: Classical Armenian.
Date: Medieval Armenian preservation of early Hellenistic Jewish testamentary lore.
